transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get this coordination huddle going. We've got Alpha and Bravo vehicle-operator recerts to schedule for next week. The training area has given us two four-hour blocks: Monday 0800-1200 and Tuesday 1300-1700. I need to get the final schedule published, so let's figure out who's evaluating Alpha and how we want to assign the cohorts to those two blocks. Bravo's evaluator will be confirmed through battalion training after this huddle, so we don't need to settle that here today. Who's got input?
